Different from the past years, the notes of 1886 show a surprising sobriety. The causes are indicated by the Servant of God herself: sickness, the “much activity” of the Work of God but most of all the interior “aversion” to put into writing the intimate things in order to be given and to be read by the spiritual director who showed a total indifference for the contents; he asked nothing and he commented on nothing. He limited himself to listening to her faults in confession and nothing more.

To this was added a state of aridity and of “darkness” in which everything became heavy for her. But the happy moments of loving union continued and she experienced them in a special way during the Holy Week and she also had communication full of the light of Jesus in spite of her problem of spiritual direction.

In addition it is to be remembered that on January 17, 1886 the inauguration of the General House in Rome destined to become the ordinary residence and operative center of the Foundress took place.

Visits of the Virgin with the Child and of Father

Bernardo

Saturday 4 April 1886. How many visits I had last night!

The first was that of the Blessed Virgin with the Child in her arm: I do not stay to explain what she left me that was great and consoling, though she said nothing. After a moment the venerable Father Bernardo Maria Clausi appeared. He was very handsome and gentle but he said nothing. He stayed for some minutes; I asked him nothing because I was enraptured and I was unable to utter a word. Tired of the toil of the day and of the discipline I did until bleeding // I rested.

But there was still another one, a sick person who looked at me languishing. I did not understand what he wanted; certainly prayers and he left me melancholy that kept me awake. I was so impressed that it seemed to me I had him always before me.

The reason for which I did not write for a long time.

Difficulty with the spiritual director

In all this time, I was not able to write because of the sickness as well as for the much activity in the Work of my

Good and also for the aversion to everything that concerned me. All became a boredom or rather it was unbearable for me; no one // asked me nor obliged me to do it; and that is why it was indifferent for me. My guide never asked me anything except once because I took aside one of our sisters whom he guided because I saw clearly that this creature had not confessed all her sins and she needed to do her confession again. I took her and I told her; she wept but she confessed everything. While I went to confession something searched for me but I finished quickly; // I always try to do my accusation and then I run away.

In this period, I had many and infinite things: first apparitions and then words; and my side…

Oh, how many times I feel like fainting when the ribs rise! Oh, sweet Love! Intimate notes year per year - 1886

The swelling that I have is such that if it were not for my Good who is inside this heart what would become of me? I could not live for an instant.

What I feel, only you my Good, who is the Author could say it. And the afflictions? //

Difficulty in vocal prayer: aridity and obscurity

Last night, 8 (…) I saw the scourge that was prepared for Sicily: a terrible earthquake. What a pain! But my dear daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore assured me that they will be exempt and would not suffer. She encouraged me to write about it to one of the benefactors of the Work and I did it immediately.1

Finally, today I was able to make some vocal prayers after a long time. My prayer was union with God and contemplation in perfect // detachment from earthly things. I felt much estrangement from the biggest as well as from the smallest things. My mind was in my God, in my sweet Love, my dear Crucifix, and Good of every immense good.

I feel much darkness that occupies me making it seem as though I am someone for whom there could be nothing to relieve me. It is as if I am in a sepulcher where everything is dark and gloomy; I see and find everything heavy, the most painful and consoling; // nothing helps me. Oh, painful state! There are moments in which I feel a strong snatch as if I were shaken from such a deep sleep. I feel a strong union that my side, my ribs…

This is over and there I am as before sunk in my immense misery.

In these moments I see and hear many things: the announcement of death of people I know, Bishops, priests,

Cardinals, etc…

Souls as black as charcoal. Ardent desire of suffering

What a terrible impression I had at the sight of a heart black as charcoal and near it even the soul dark and very small! // I received the explanation but I did not know the identity.

Since many times my Good showed me the spirit of one or the other black ones, I saw very big ones, as black as charcoal. I desired the explanation and I was given it. Those big and very black ones were… //

How I suffer! And yet I always feel an ardent desire to suffer more. I never find a way of satisfying myself. In this

Lent I obtained approval to increase the penances and the discipline until bleeding. Oh, Jesus, not even this can I offer you anymore because the flesh comes out, but there is no bleeding!

I can say that on all sides of my pig I feel pain: the hands, the legs and my side, these are on their own and then on the other side there is an entirely different pain.

How I find it difficult to wake up after sleeping! // I feel as a dead person who goes on putting together her bones to stand on my feet. Oh, spasm!

Holy Week 1886. An offering to Jesus in the Sacrament

Holy Thursday: at midnight, after having done a very fierce discipline until bleeding acute pains afflicted me so much that I had fever; I seemed to be in a furnace.

At half past four the pain was such that I could not bear it and I was fainting for the pains in my hands, in the legs, in the heart and on the side; it was entirely a spasmodic Intimate notes year per year - 1886 pain. The ribs were so raised that I felt much pain. I had to call for help; // covered by the fever I was able to delude the one who helped me and I remained in bed the whole of Friday.

The next day was Saturday at eight in the morning, I woke up for Holy Communion but I still felt pain. The pains of the discipline were added and I could stand with difficulty.

As soon as I reached the chapel I received the Holy Communion. Oh, my Love, what happened to me before receiving you!

As usual I did the offering. Oh, sweet Love! I heard an interior voice that suggested to me how I should make the offering.

“My Jesus in the Sacrament, // I offer you yourself, offering you my Communion. What can I offer you that could be worthy of you if not yourself, because you yourself are your own pleasure. In yourself you find the only object that is worthy of you; therefore in the offering that I make to you of yourself, my Good, deign to come in me; certainly you will not refuse to welcome this miserable creature. Oh, my dear Love, I posses you, I am in you while I offer you yourself in me, I offer you my nothingness, I do not even posses.”

When // repeatedly I made this offering of himself, my Good allowed me to see and to feel how much he was pleased with this offering and as if an interior voice suggested to me I continued with certain expressions which I was repeating in my intellect and reasoning; now I am no more able to gather them together. Oh, what I felt! As I finished I asked:

  • Who suggested me?

Oh, my Love, embrace me tightly in you to be only one thing with you, my Good! Oh, my Love! //

As I recovered I asked for the conversion of two sinners. As soon as I said this, a fire came down upon me on the side; it seemed as though flames were coming out. Oh, what I felt! Yes, my Good consume me, destroy me!

MEMOIRS - SECTION II

The gift of pain to the provincial of Bolivia

Beside my bed was the provincial of Bolivia and I felt compassion because she suffered when she left me. The compassion was such that I was induced by pity and gave her a gift.

  • Well – I said – I will give you (…) if it is pleasing to my

Good – because I was feeling strongly moved to do it. //

I took her right hand, I held it tightly and I impressed in it the pain I had in me; and she really said that she felt it much.

I said to her:

  • This is my remembrance, I am poor, I have nothing to give you but this, because on this miserable earth I posses nothing to give you as a small gift but only suffering.

Oh, how much she thanked me and what a joy that creature felt! It was without compare. Yes, only in suffering the delights of the dear spouse, my beloved Jesus, are found.

She felt this suffering always especially after Holy

Communion.2

Jesus: “You are dearer to me in suffering than in adoration”

How many beasts! One was so big that it seemed // to be devouring me. It was more than one and a half meters long and had a very ridiculous tail. There were also other small signs of an epidemic but not grave things, and other very painful sufferings for the Work.

On Friday I suffered a strong headache; I almost lost my senses because I was raving; but I understood I was raving. I was alone closed in the room because the spasm was such Intimate notes year per year - 1886 that I was not able to stand. As soon as I was able to gather together a word having a bit of respite, I said:

  • My Good, make this terrible sickness cease, I cannot bear it anymore; I promise that soon I will come // to your feet and I will take an hour of adoration. Oh, what did my Good answer? He said:

  • You are dearer to me in suffering than in adoration.

He left me strength, resignation and calm; although my mind was upset because of the strong spasm. But everything encouraged me to suffer more.

In a creature I saw clearly a spirit who made her irascible. It was unbelievable for she was a very good soul; however, because of the mercy of God it did not win her. //

My dear daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore is of true comfort to me because she always replies to every request of mine.

Light on the problem of the director

Today, an interior voice made me feel that my guide had many souls under his guidance and he believed them to be holy but they were openly pious humbugs. I had this always before me especially in the church until I said:

  • Jesus, why should I pray with this?

It was not my usual, but it was really curious. He told me that the director will suffer for certain slanders and in // addition he showed me that he wanted to take certain determination; in the mind he saw something that spurred him to do what he was suggested but in the intimacy of his heart he had something different.

He drove me to tell him but I did not have the courage; Jesus desired that he give heed to his heart and not to his mind. I had a reproach and I said:

  • Jesus for pity’s sake, I have no courage! He is the cause because he guides me so aridly and a force overcomes me; pity, my Love! //

MEMOIRS - SECTION II

A grace regarding the Institute, missed as punishment for the gratification she received

In these days, how much I had to combat with Satan, I cannot describe it…

What terrible pains I felt when I saw a Daughter of St.

Anne committing certain faults! My Good had promised me that as long as I live this sin will never be committed.

Until the seventeenth year it never happened and I pointed this out strongly to the Congregation of Bishops and

Regular. Finally, I almost used it as a defense when they made certain accusations regarding the novitiate. But now, no more! // I lamented with my Good saying:

  • Why did the grace you promised not continue?

An interior voice answered me:

  • To punish your gratification.

Oh, it was true, my God, that I felt gratified. Oh, what pain I felt and I promised not to mention it anymore and to keep quiet; to let people tell me and accept everything with humility, never defending myself.

What a miserable person I am. Pity, my Good! So lonely, without being able to ask for an advice. What a painful situation to suffer without // comfort! Intimate notes year per year - 1887

On 11 June she communicated to her that the prophecy of an earthquake had become true, since according to the news received the day before, on 10 April, strong shaking upset the entire region of Etna. Again with another letter on 26 June to the same Princess she reassured her that according to a reply of Sister Anne del Salvatore, the city of Palermo would not be affected by cholera.

A long interruption of more than a year for the reasons hinted above came again. The year 1887 was a year of much travels throughout Italy. On January 2 she left Rome to start to visit the houses of Naples, Puglia, Calabria and Sicily. On this journey she was accompanied by her son Alessandro – we do not know if it was only for the moment of the passage of the straits of Messina – because she had received threatening letters from Messina: the Mafia or the Masons wanted to kill her.

An important event was the solemn dedication of the church of the General House on May 1, 1887. In the months from July to October she visited the houses of Toscana. Again on October 28 she left for Naples where she remained until November 15.

From the month of June, Mother Rosa returned to fill the pages of the notebook, because the Lord is happy that she does it. She felt the need of displaying before God what he communicated to her; the wonderful way in which the supreme Good sustained and led his Work and also all that she suffered in aridity and in the abandonment, when she was persuaded of having lost her God.

While she wrote, her spirit rebelled at the idea of having to give again her notes to be read by someone and she regretted having done it earlier. She accepted the will of God who spurred her to continue under the “arid direction” of Father Portogruaro.

As usual she lived intensely the events of the Institute and in a beautiful reflection she expressed disappointment

MEMOIRS - SECTION II when she observed less evangelic competition among the religious Institutes, among which there should be a “holy competition to do all the good in order to give glory to Jesus.” Another beautiful reflection about the treasure of poverty promised in the religious profession follows.

Interesting was the digression on the much human affection towards the confessor observed in many religious. It is interesting also the reflection which follows about some directors who run of making mistakes in the guidance of the beginners. Remarkable as well as enigmatic is the vision she had in the month of November in which Jesus the crucified appeared to her with his side open.

Human consolations are not for Mother Rosa; abandoned by God and by human beings, she has nothing but the “only pure suffering”. The permission given to her by the director to continue the corporal penances doing them as much as she wanted for the novena of the Child was a relief for her.

Finally, in the interior life of Mother Rosa the influence of Monsignor Granito Pignatelli di Belmonte can be seen; the direction of the General of the Franciscans is definitively cut. Intimate notes year per year - 1887

Replay of a priest about her spirit. The secret of

“what is found in the side of her heart”

It is two o’clock after midnight on 21 July 1887. Tormented horribly I woke up and after praying I felt driven to write; I hardly know anymore where and how to start after many months. In all this time, I wrote only two lines and then I missed time.

Ordered by my director I was subjected to an examination on my spirit by a priest of a holy life. After having examined me well (which he did in a moment) he said and wrote: that in me the creature should not be seen but the work of the creator. //

I was amazed at how well he knew that it has always been and is the superfine Craftsman who worked and still works in me and for me and that looking at the creature there is nothing but misery and nothingness. What could such a sick and worn out body do!

While the priest heard my confession he told me what he saw on the side of the heart where the ribs raise up; something great but he was not able to understand it well. I went for adoration because my Good was exposed // and after some minutes I remained absorbed. He showed me clearly what was there but forbade me to say it and he promised me that he would not allow anybody to understand or to see it. This servant of the Lord said that he would have prayed much until Jesus had granted him the grace of knowing or seeing what is there; but not, he obtained nothing.

Oh, in these days how my ribs were raised up, what I felt!

What should I say of the impression that I received when I saw that? I wept for consolation and I was so united with my Good // that it is not given me to describe what I felt!1

MEMOIRS - SECTION II

A vision she had on the day of the feast of St. Anne

The day of St. Anne, my mother, July 1887. Right from the eve I felt in me indescribable things but I cannot explain them. From the first of the month I felt urged to stop in Rome for the feast of the saint; as usual I was guided by my Good because I felt a hand that made me act and even if at certain times I wanted to do things differently his strength overcame me and stopped me. But I have to say // that with the mercy of God I never resisted. I am even careful to be ready to follow the orders of my Master and beloved Spouse.

Therefore in the morning, I went to the private chapel where I did my meditation and I had the Mass at the beginning of which I received Holy Communion.

I made prayers, entreaties to the Holy Mother so that she may accept the vows that the daughters made and renewed; that she may give // perseverance to all and she may not allow anyone to fail. I felt much union that seemed to me that I found myself with all the Daughters of St. Anne to receive their vows. The Holy Mother appeared to me very busy receiving papers; she was taking and keeping them near her on a table and she sealed and placed them one over the other; but there were some on which there was not written anything: these she threw away. However I remember very well that she also threw few written ones;

she looked and then she threw; but it seemed to me those she threw // could not reach twenty.

She was very delighted as she put one paper over the other and sealed them as when the stamp of our house is put on important papers.

The consolation that I felt was such that as the vision ended I was touched and secretly I had to shed two tears. Intimate notes year per year - 1887 And what did I feel in my thanksgiving! I do not know! The soul inebriated spoke with the Holy Mother in a // heavenly manner for it seemed to me that I have her always before me. Though I had many distractions, in that day I was not distracted from the strong union with God and I always had that feeling that I felt in the morning.

Assisted by the Lord in visiting the houses

The next day in journey, I suffered being with lay people. But everything that could be sacrificed for Jesus is little. He left me with strength that I went on saying within me:

  • How strong is your Spirit! Revive and give strength to those who have // not.

I looked at myself: - Am I?

  • My Good, no, you are in me and not me.

I visited various houses and where I found lack of observance, what I felt! Though I had to dissimulate because the superiors tried all they could to hide so that I would not realize the disorder all the same I did not fail to be instructed by my Good and I always discovered everything.

I received a visit from my daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore and I entrusted to her certain things; I also asked her if I was granted providence and she answered… //

Little by little I saw the epidemic but it was something of no importance; it was more prevalent in Sicily.

A terrible beast came to frighten me as I woke from sleep – I hardly slept – it left me so sick that I woke up and strolled with a terrible convulsion which made me tremble. Oh, if I could always narrate about these beasts I do not know how many volumes I could write!

I feared that I could not resist certain activities of the Work of the Lord; not at all! // With my amazement I saw them done and I could not know how.

Oh, my Master, he not only teaches me but he is also active.

MEMOIRS - SECTION II

Induced to loosen the chain after the advice of the one who read her writings

In the past twenty days, I felt much suffering of all kinds; today, there was a bit of calm.

I do not know, I kept the chain very much inside the flesh and it produced certain wounds that were painful. I kept it like that for four months; the day before yesterday I shifted it and for a while I loosened it.

A person to whom I do not know how I gave my writings to read and to whom I told about my things // (M…)2 wrote telling me to lay down certain pointed instruments. I took it with indifference and moreover the devil suggested to me and tormented me horribly showing me that I did bad to make such communication. Therefore I have been the executioner of myself doing something that should not be done. I would need too much time if I have to describe everything that this monster said to me annoying me much.

On that day having no one // to trouble me, it troubled me on the head; it did every kind of things. The headache, the torments, the fact that I had to remain lying down with much work to be done, the words or rather the one written to me by that (M…) induced me to wake up again and shift the chain. I felt improving but my poor head, how much it pained! Worn out in this way by the continuous thought, I hoped to sleep but did not; the monster tormented me the whole night and in the morning I was more tired than ever:

now it moved the bed, and then // the beasts came in.

Jesus is happy that she writes her experiences

Having restarted to write, how I felt that my Good made me internally feel always this: Intimate notes year per year - 1887

  • I am happy.

He gave me strength to do it by taking away the headache and whenever the pain starts it makes it cease; because I have to do this after the rosary, always at half past nine, as soon as I retire into the room, certainly very tired especially in the head as this evening.

I was in the church with a headache and I thought I could not // do it because I was afraid it could become stronger; but it did not. As soon as I started to write, everything disappeared. As I write beside my Crucifix everything is in silence. If it were not for obedience only my Good could say of what kind it is. I do not know. It seems to me to have something that I cannot explain. At midnight I try to leave everything and I sleep.

Excessive affection of many souls to their confessors

I would like to be able to explain what // is always before me: many good souls, especially women, all the female sex, for many of them their good remains as the powder dispersed by wind; and why? Because of the too much affection for the confessors. Oh, yes, I can say that for the majority it is a terrible sight which gives me much pain, because I also see that there is…

I am afraid of offending by writing … my Jesus! I stop saying this. It is his will, but certainly they are // deluded. Oh, the true love is devoid of any affection, even of the most sacred.

“Oh, my Love, how you maintain and direct your Institute!”

The day before yesterday, 3 September, while I did my thanksgiving for Holy Communion, it was given me to see how my Saviour and Master acts in his Work. Oh, how I would have been happy if as soon as I came out of the church I could have been able to write everything that had happened to me and what I saw!

MEMOIRS - SECTION II

Oh, my Love, now I understand everything! To see some young in a sad plight, when clothed they change completely and you adorn them with your divine Spirit // and then you give to this ass the impulse to send them now here, then there and also to make them superiors while still young and inexperienced. They go and do great things with an extraordinary courage. I always knew that it was your work and how you made me understand with what excellence you invest them and communicate to them much strength and ability even to the most ignorant as I am in the direction of houses and hospitals and they direct them very well! You maintain and direct // your Institute!

Oh, is it because I do not know how to explain everything well? What a pain! He does not need direction.

Now I understand certain things which made me fear, but now that there is nothing hidden, calmly I let go of everything by itself, thinking that everything is ordered by my Good.

Blessed Mary my Mother, what a sweet thought is that of knowing that my Good takes care to provide the creatures for his Work as he wants.

The work that // my poor head does is because my

Good allows his slave to toil in order to complete the work.

He could save the world without much suffering, but did not. This was needed so that the work of Redemption may be ransomed by the blood of a God from the slavery and be perfectly accomplished.

My Good your saying is so excellent that I fear when I must repeat certain thing because I am very mean. Make beautiful and change into good what I cannot // express with the pen.

As a dead body that neither thinks nor speaks

On the eve of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin the day was very bad and it continued the same; though it was late at night I felt an intense sickness. I suffered because I Intimate notes year per year - 1887 seemed to be in a deep abyss. Unrest took me and I did examination after examination. I could not even pray because such was the effort I had to make in order to say two Our Fathers – Hail Marys – Glory that all the anxieties came upon me. It seemed that I would faint; the head pained, such a trembling // seized me that I cannot explain. What could I do? To keep quiet and to try to concentrate mentally? Worse! A confusion of ideas and a cold sweat came upon me; what pains? It was given to me only to throw myself at the feet of my Good as a dead body that neither thinks nor speaks anything, in silence. I felt I was not alone but with my Good and in this way I found a moment of peace.

I cannot explain my painful state; I do not speak of lack of comfort, but the continuous torture that I feel // and the strong pains that prevent me from prayer. I feel a continuous unrest, it seems to me I have a calling, I do not know. My God, what a painful state! I try all I can to retire to my room; it is the only comfort but I am deprived of the thought of meditation, nothing! As a body abandoned in suffering, I can assure that I do not have a side of this pig that has no pain; I try to dissimulate the suffering I feel but many times it escapes me; alas, I feel sick. // I then regret and I would like to return to conceal what I said.

Terrible nights.

“I have lost my Good, the Being of my life!”

How I suffered at the sight of two small stars which moved around me! For one, which was the first, I had to suffer for the whole night spasms and torturing pains. After I received the news that this poor creature was dying of cholera, suffering tortures. I had been present to assist these. But not the other one; however, I suffered. My side was added to this; the bones were moving in a certain way accompanied // by sweet but strong pain. In such a cruel state, my Good deprived me of his teachings. I do not know

MEMOIRS - SECTION II how and where to find him; perhaps I merited to be punished?

Unfortunately I understand that I am one of the bad creatures, my Love, let everything be suffering for me, but not the deprivation of seeing you, no. Oh, this one kills me!

I ask you how I should do this and the other and you tell me nothing; poor me, wherever am I! //

This evening I will discipline myself twice until bleeding and I will tighten the chain because two days ago I had loosened it a bit since it was inside the flesh especially on one side. Since I had a bit of breathlessness I thought better to loosen it a bit; but this evening I will tighten it more.

How can I know if my Good will be happy; I do not know anymore where he is. Oh, what pains! Yes, I merit them, but these ones no, my Love! //

I see that for me everything is finished; a gloomy anxiety invades me completely. Resigned in the deep suffering it seems to me that I cannot live and I have dread of myself.

The strength fails me because violence exhausts the body. I feel sick because of a bit of fever that consumes my strength. I feel a trembling that makes me almost faint at every moment. Oh, I lost my God, I am lost! There is nothing more for me. // Therefore, what should I do? Oh,

I would do nothing but weep and then my head, and his

Work!

My Good, do you always leave me in these pains? In these days there are all the deprivations. My pains are such that they take the sleep away. I do not sleep even for one hour. What can I do, pray? What can I? Think? What? In my mind everything disappears!

This night while writing, I felt a terrible fright and went on asking myself what it was and from where it came. //

Upset I woke up and wrote to see if it would cease but it did not. I had to struggle much to avoid calling someone and to wait until day came; I burned much and I had fire.

Alas, I felt swelling in the hands and the whole head; unable to sleep I felt pain. I asked myself, what I should do; what a desolation! Intimate notes year per year - 1887

I have lost my Good, the Being of my life and in this way everything is painful. What terrible nights! I certainly committed something bad. Oh, my God, have // pity on me!

She regretted having given her writings to be read.

Under an arid direction

To have given part of my writings to be read is a real torment for me in these days. I do not know what to think if I did bad or not; because I had strong impulses and I could almost say commands; and more so what happened to me was truly extraordinary, it never happened to me before.

Therefore, why much uproar and sufferings of a new type now? I would have never believed that I could reach to such an extent, my Good; another time I will not care // about anything and I will be firm, all these writings I have I will never give them out; it costs me much!3

If I had to describe how much the devil does to me I would need much! I am alone with my Good, unknown to the world that I have always been able to deceive covering well everything that takes place in me with my Good which nobody had penetrated. Only the direction that Jesus gave me to be subjected as he said under // an arid direction. That is how it happened and I am still with full power to increase the penances and to do as I think best. And in giving an account, I do not know, my Good, how you chose … Immediately exactness… but which lasted a while; everything was willed by God. It is a holy soul without more explanation… because he said to me that it was for me a mere suffering. Yes, he said it very well, because I do not know what to do. Many months and then? Alas, // on this I cannot return.

MEMOIRS - SECTION II

Only you, my Good, even hidden as you are and it is a horrible pain, yes, you alone are and you will always be my director. I am always ready to do your most holy will, in everything though it is hard and tormenting every time that

I must submit myself to say something but however terrible it can be, nothing will ever stop me.

There is no martyrdom which can come to arrest me, no!

Two terrible nights of apparition, darkness and abandonment

Last 8 September I spent a terrible night, what pains! //

That enemy did to me of every kind, not even for one hour was I able to sleep. At four o’clock, half - asleep, it seemed to me like a balm that I was to sleep. Not at all! After half an hour they knocked on my door; - but first the lamp went off and there was a strong smell! – After someone called me, knocking as if it was the sister who calls, but with a certain voice grumbling that within myself I said:

  • How does she speak?

And I answered:

  • Blessed be for ever.

I jumped from the bed and I opened the // window; dawn was breaking barely and I returned to sleep. Not at all! The sleep was ended. Worn out I woke up after the real call which the sister made. My God!

Certain signs appeared to me on the wall but I was not able to understand well. They seemed to me to indicate epidemics, but I would not know; confusion, wars and the

Pope with the red hat. It was a real scourge of worries because as one thing passed soon another one came. I could not pray;

The five notebooks, which contain the notes of 1889, belong to booklets 9 and 11. Until July 10 the diary pursues with certain regularity, indicating the dates with precision. Then it is interrupted until September 14; this time not for lack of time but for other reasons:

Finally I did not want anymore to start this book narrating painful things; in this way I always resisted any impulse instead of describing my continuous pains without any comfort.”

In fact, the description of the events of this year was started with interior “panoramic” of light and expansions of love, of cheerfulness in suffering, of long raptures of angelic visions and of joyful news about the Daughters of St. Anne. The grace of loving contemplation had already become a habit. She felt comforted by the Lord as preparation for new battles. These never fail, as well as the ugly anxieties and temptations; but the unrest remains on the surface and the Servant of God can affirm:

“Nothing upsets me; interiorly I am always immersed in sweet consolation. I feel that there is in me one who works for me and makes me act… It seems to me that the world does not exist anymore for me…The meditations are a sweet rest…”

“The peace of my soul increases more I would say that it is in a gentle sleep of love as the bride of the Canticles sleeps

“I am always very calm while in the past there was an abyss of turbulence and unrest. Now everything is calm and peaceful; the sweetness and certainty that I feel is such that nothing can disturb me.”

It seems to me that it could be said that these first six months of 1889 place us before a Rosa Gattorno in some way different, more real and I would say more attractive. The intimacy with God becomes more nuptial. On Holy Thursday she had an unusual experience.

The impression is different in the second part of the year; to the interior causes a real “exhaustion” is added; she is no longer in a position neither of thinking nor of speaking and not even of praying. In this interior climate of darkness, as of a dark cave to which the fear of having offended God is added, a new kiss of the supreme Good assures her of his spousal love.
